messages:
Maya: Seeing a sudden tail-latency spike in eu-west racks, telemetry shows repeated PCIe retries on a handful of hosts. Noticing elevated pcie_err counters and NVLink drops. Example from node gc-ru-12:
```
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] pcie: device 0000:65:00.0: AER: Corrected error status: 00000001
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] gpu0: nvlink: peer reset, retrying
```
Anyone else seeing this or a noisy tenant? :eyes:

Dom: Looking at alloc traces — a single tenant (acct: vehicledx) has huge sustained small-inference traffic from multiple pods, pins to same AZ and coincides with iostat/pcie spikes.

Frank: If it's sustained tiny requests, KV cache churn could be thrashing memory and generating PCIe traffic. Can you paste the alloc ids (alloc-*)?

Maya: allocs: alloc-7f1b2, alloc-7f1b3, alloc-7f1b4. Mostly fractionals on rack eu-w-12.

sre_jen: Propose immediate soft-quarantine for those allocs so we stop cross-host noise while we investigate. Quick command: `rbctl allocator quarantine --alloc=alloc-7f1b2,alloc-7f1b3,alloc-7f1b4 --duration=60m --reason="pcie-noise"`

Kai: Also suggest enabling egress shaping on that tenant and apply kvcache shield rules to reduce remote fetches. Small config patch (CLI):
```
rbctl tenant update vehicledx --egress-qos=low-burst --kvcache-shield=true
```
Should reduce PCIe/NVLink storms.

Frank: Agree. Quick mitigation plan: 1) quarantine allocs 2) apply kvcache & egress QoS 3) migrate remaining hot fractionals to a temporary dedicated slice if possible. Migration command: `rbctl slice create --name temp-vehicledx --gpu=1xA100 --labels=isolated` then `rbctl migrate --alloc alloc-7f1b4 --to-slice=temp-vehicledx`

Maya: Running quarantine now. InfraBot, will you post a short alert to #incidents with affected hosts?

InfraBot: [alert] Created incident INC-2026-0330-42: "eu-west PCIe retry spike — quarantine applied to vehicledx". Auto-notify oncall.

Dom: FYI this tenant is on reserved plan — moving them to a temporary dedicated slice has cost implications. Estimated delta ~$1.2k/day if kept for >24h. Do we want finance sign-off?

sre_jen: Keep it for max 2 hours, monitor. If noise persists, we escalate to product and sales for billing conversation. For now safety first. :thumbsup:

Kai: After quarantine, watch pcie_err and NVLink resets. Also dump GPU telemetry: `rbctl telemetry dump --hosts gc-ru-12,gc-ru-13 --since 10m > /tmp/pcie-dump.log` and attach to INC ticket + link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pcie-noise

Frank: Rollback plan: if metrics normalized for 30m, revert quarantine: `rbctl allocator unquarantine --alloc=alloc-7f1b2,alloc-7f1b3,alloc-7f1b4` and remove temp slice. If not normalized, open a change to carve out a permanent fractional isolation or longer dedicated reservation.

Maya: Quarantine applied, telemetry already shows drop in pcie_err on gc-ru-12. Will keep monitoring and post updates in INC. Thanks all. :heart:

Dom: Creating follow-up ticket for cost reconcile and tenant contact (S-4567).

Frank: Nice work. Also add a short-term metric alert for pcie_err rate per-rack so we catch regressions earlier.

Maya: Will do. Last update here unless anything urgent.
